dct_description_sm: The objective of this project was to assess the vulnerability of Atlin, B.C. to environmental hazards and stresses resulting from changes in climatic conditions. The project aimed to establish a climate change scenario in collaboration with the community. Following this first step, a Climate Change Adaptation Plan was developed to address community vulnerability.
